## Setup

### Load packages

```{r}
library(fs)
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(survival)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)
library(glue)
```

### Set Threshold for P(Benefit)

```{r}
threshold <- 0.95
```

### Functions

```{r}
source("./functions/jackknife_mcse.R")
source("./functions/summarise-posterior.R")
source("./functions/summarise-iterations.R")
source("./functions/plot-rhat.R")
source("./functions/plot-p-benefit.R")
source("./functions/plot-posterior-distribution.R")
source("./functions/load-draws.R")
source("./functions/load-rhat-values.R")
```

## Load data

```{r}
path <- "./3-survival/output/sim-HA-09/"
param_draws <- load_draws(path)
rhat <- load_rhat_values(path = path)

rmst_files <- dir_ls(
    path = path, 
    glob = "*/rmst_results.rds", 
    recurse = TRUE
)

rmst_draws <- rbindlist(lapply(rmst_files, function(file_path) {
    dt <- readRDS(file_path)
    iter_num <- as.integer(stringr::str_extract(file_path, "(?<=run_)\\d+"))
    dt[, iter := iter_num]
    dt
}))
```

## Summarise RMST Results

```{r}
prob_benefit_per_sim <- rmst_draws[, .(prob_benefit = mean(rmst_diff > 0)), by = iter]

power_estimates <- prob_benefit_per_sim$prob_benefit >= threshold
power <- mean(power_estimates)
power_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(power_estimates)
power
power_mcse

median_rmst_diff_per_sim <- rmst_draws[, .(median_diff = median(rmst_diff)), by = iter]
overall_mean_rmst_diff <- mean(median_rmst_diff_per_sim$median_diff)
TRUE_RMST_DIFF <- 3
bias <- round(overall_mean_rmst_diff - TRUE_RMST_DIFF, digit = 1)
bias_mcse <- jackknife_mcse(median_rmst_diff_per_sim$median_diff)
```
